session.title: Chat Session
session.description: A single anonymous chat session containing conversation history and expiration metadata.

lastActiveAt.description: Timestamp of the last message sent in this session

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when this session should be automatically cleaned up (30 days after creation)

messages.description: List of messages in the conversation

contactInfo.description: User's contact details, Google user profile string, or Sri Lankan WhatsApp phone number

userEmail.description: User's email address from Google Auth or contact submission

directContactNumber.description: User-provided direct telephone or WhatsApp number

needsAdminAttention.description: True if user requested personal support/notification from the admin

adminNotifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the user triggered admin notification

user.title: Registered / Verified User
user.description: Information about users who verified their age or logged in with Google Authentication or Username.

id.description: User UID from Google Auth or Username Auth

email.description: User's verified Google email address or username identifier

displayName.description: User's Google display name or registered username

createdAt.description: When the user first signed in or verified

lastLoginAt.description: When the user was last active

lastSessionId.description: Most recent session ID associated with this user

sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores user chat sessions anonymously. Only readable/deletable by admins or updateable anonymously to append messages.

users/{userId}.description: Stores verified Google user profiles. Writable by the user themselves upon login, readable and listable by administrators.
